preprocessingConfig.exclusionJustification: Direct identifiers (user_id, username, ip_address) are strictly excluded to prevent overfitting, identity memorization, and subnet bias, ensuring the model learns invariant behavioral anomaly patterns applicable to new unobserved users and IPs. The "action" field is excluded to prevent target leakage as it represents downstream post-incident enforcement decisions.
